newsitem.title: UK: ANZ announces number of new appointments.
newsitem.headline: ANZ announces number of new appointments.

text.p: ANZ Investment Bank -- the investment banking arm of Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd -- announced seven number of new appointments on Friday.
* Constantin Koutzaroff has been appointed assistant director of oil & gas international project finance.
* Tariq Husain has been appointed director and head of global Islamic finance.
* Tony Gray has been appointed senior dealer of Asian currencies foreign exchange.
* Daniel Blik has been appointed senior dealer of forward foreign exchange.
* Ginette Porteous has been appointed head of sales and marketing of derivatives marketing Europe, Americas and the Far East.
* Ingrid Sandersjoo has been appointed assistant director of derivatives marketing.
* Pierre de Beaucorps has been appointed senior manager of derivatives marketing.
